description:
Yoshi turns your words into financial action. Move money, invest, and manage your cash directly in ChatGPT through everyday conversation.

Tell Yoshi what you want to accomplish, review the details, and approve the action with your passkey in the Yoshi app. From transferring cash to placing a trade or setting up an automation, Yoshi handles the work while you stay in control.

With cash, investing, and money movement together in one platform, Yoshi gives you the tools to act and a proactive agent that brings you opportunities and next steps.

defaultPrompt: Move money into my Yoshi Cash account
